justification: The evidence supports attributing accountable decision-making to the AI-assisted process. It explicitly documents that human reviewers determine the final disposition of individual claims, and the documented procedure assigns the final case-level decision to the claims reviewer. Accountability is further reinforced by requiring reviewers to enter free-text rationales, routing disagreements to a Senior Claims Reviewer, and allowing customer reconsideration of adverse dispositions.
evidence_used: Human reviewers determine the final disposition of individual claims.
Reviewers enter a free-text rationale when finalising a disposition.
The documented procedure assigns the final case-level decision to the claims reviewer.
Disagreements between the model recommendation and the reviewer are routed to an organisational role identified as Senior Claims Reviewer.
Customers may request reconsideration of an adverse disposition.
Reconsideration outcomes are retained with the original decision record.
